values.meaning: Deadly Venom stacks applied per cast (on landing plus each second the zone persists)
values.quote: ''Venom Cask'' can apply a maximum of 4 {{ai|Deadly Venom|Twitch}} stacks per enemy per cast.
values.binNote: The sheet has no data value stating 4 directly; only the zone Duration=3 exists (1 stack on landing + 1 per second for 3 seconds = 4, per the wiki's note), so this count comes from the wiki text alone.

values.quote: The area then becomes contaminated for 3 seconds

values.meaning: Zone tick interval (Deadly Venom stack applied per tick)
values.quote: applying a ''{{ai|Deadly Venom|Twitch}}'' stack each second to enemies within
values.binNote: The sheet has no explicit tick-interval data value; the 1-second cadence is only stated in the wiki's description text.

mechanics.claim: Venom Cask's cask applies a Deadly Venom stack to enemies hit when it lands.
mechanics.quote: applying ''{{ai|Deadly Venom|Twitch}}'' to enemies in the area and granting {{tip|sight}} of it.

mechanics.claim: After landing, Venom Cask leaves a zone that applies another Deadly Venom stack once per second for 3 seconds to enemies standing in it, separate from the stacks basic attacks apply on-hit.
mechanics.quote: The area then becomes contaminated for 3 seconds, applying a ''{{ai|Deadly Venom|Twitch}}'' stack each second to enemies within
